intro: Ornery Ornery Galestriders concerns an orchard farmer in the Gustberry Lowlands struggling with a meager seasonal harvest. The local lowlands galestriders—larger and more vicious than their highland kin—have been raiding the orchard for stormapples and threatening the farm's livelihood. Culling the aggressive birds secures the remaining fruit while providing much-needed fresh tenderloins for dinner.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.
Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... Well, too long.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.
